findings.current: They said they didn’t realize the enemy was there until they’d reached a point only three hundred *li* from Dunhuang.
findings.defect: The draft makes the defenders travel to the point where they detect the enemy; the enemy is the force that advanced toward Dunhuang.
findings.rationale: The enemy’s undetected approach explains why the scouts at Jade Gate Pass are presumed dead.
findings.replacement: They said the enemy wasn’t detected until it had advanced to within three hundred *li* of Dunhuang.
findings.source: 돈황의 삼백 리 앞까지 도달한 후에야 적들의 존재를 눈치챘다고 했으니 말입니다.

findings.current: *If even the messenger who escaped the battlefield first, ahead of everyone else, was that badly injured…*
findings.defect: In this context, “the messenger” can be read as the Great Snow Mountain messenger currently speaking, rather than the wounded Kongtong messenger who escaped Dunhuang.
findings.rationale: The Kongtong Disciple arrived at the Great Snow Mountain with severe injuries and died there; the messenger now speaking was sent from that mountain afterward.
findings.replacement: *If even the wounded Kongtong messenger, who must have escaped the battlefield ahead of everyone else, was injured that badly…*
findings.source: ‘가장 빨리, 누구보다 앞서 전장을 벗어났을 전령이 그 정도로 큰 부상을 입은 상태였다면…….’

findings.current: As countless blades flashed all around us, I watched our allies move in unison at the shouts ringing through the ranks and kicked off my stirrups.
findings.defect: Taekyung kicks off from the saddle, not the stirrups.
findings.rationale: 말안장 is the saddle; the action launches him into the air.
findings.replacement: As countless blades flashed all around us, I watched our allies move in unison at the shouts ringing through the ranks and kicked off from the saddle.

findings.current: During the desperate retreat, two of our Elders, both Perfected Ones, and all one hundred members of the Demon-Subduing Squad were left to die at Dunhuang.
findings.defect: “Our Elders” wrongly makes the Great Snow Mountain messenger a member of Kongtong, while “were left to die” suggests the fighters were abandoned alive rather than reporting their deaths.
findings.rationale: The casualties belong to the Kongtong Sect, and 돈황에 뼈를 묻었다 reports that they died there.
findings.replacement: During the desperate retreat, two Perfected Ones serving as Kongtong Elders and all one hundred members of the Demon-Subduing Squad died at Dunhuang.
findings.source: 다급하게 퇴각하는 과정에서 장로직을 맡고 계신 두 분의 진인(眞人)과 복마대(伏魔隊) 일백 전원이 돈황에 뼈를 묻었다고 합니다.

findings.current: Ten thousand. A full ten thousand!
findings.defect: The draft drops a leader’s spoken disbelief that so many troops were defeated so easily and turns the dialogue into narration.
findings.rationale: The source gives the first reaction to a speaker, then has Taekyung repeat the number in narration.
findings.replacement:
“Ten thousand. A full ten thousand! How could a force that large be defeated so easily?”

Yes. Ten thousand. A full ten thousand.
findings.source:
“일만. 무려 일만이오! 한데 그 많은 병력이 그리 손쉽게 격파당했다니.”

그래, 일만.

무려 일만이다.

findings.defect: The correction changes from the number of living scouts to whether they remain stationed at the pass.
findings.rationale: The emphasis on 일백‘이었다’ anticipates that all hundred scouts are probably dead.
findings.replacement: No—there *had* been at least a hundred.

summary: The draft changes who detected the enemy and which messenger escaped the battlefield. It also shifts a saddle action, misattributes Kongtong’s Elders, and drops a speaker’s reaction.
